resources.string: Xóa tất cả tuyến đã lưu?
After clearing, Mika works things out step by step again next time. Other settings aren’t affected.
%1$s · used once network access is on
For model requests, updates, the in-app browser and commands

Used for Mika’s model requests (chat, model lists, account sign-in), in-app update downloads, the in-app browser, and commands in Files & computing environment while network access is on there. Addresses on this phone or your local network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, names ending in .local) always connect directly, so local models keep working. It may include user:password@, stored encrypted on this phone. Leave empty for a direct connection.
Write it as http://host:port (socks5, socks5h and https work too), optionally with user:password@ before the host.
https:// proxies are only used by commands in Files & computing environment; Mika’s own connections stay direct. Use http:// or socks5:// to cover everything.
This phone’s WebView can’t use a separate proxy, so the in-app browser connects directly.
The in-app browser can’t use a SOCKS proxy that needs a user name and password, so it connects directly.
Couldn’t reach the network proxy, or it didn’t pass the request on. Check that the proxy is running and that the address in Settings › Network proxy is right.
The network proxy rejected the user name or password. Check them in Settings › Network proxy.
Not set: commands connect directly. Change it in Settings › Network proxy
%1$s · change it in Settings › Network proxy
Không gian làm việc trò chuyện
A task is running in this chat; it can’t be cleared now
Files in the workspace of “%1$s” will be deleted: attachments you sent, screens you shared and files tasks wrote. The chat itself stays, but those files in it won’t open any more.
Files in every chat’s workspace will be deleted: attachments, shared screens and files tasks wrote. Chats stay. Chats with a running task are skipped.
The runtime and skills come with the app and aren’t cleared here; to start over, use “Reset environment” above.
Light or dark, whichever the phone is in
Uses the main color in the image instead of the accent color above, when it has one
Let Mika change its own settings

When on, tasks get one tool to read and change these preferences (pace, mute, capsule, appearance, accent color, screen-on). Models, API keys, container network and anything that deletes data are never included
Giới hạn bước mỗi tác vụ
Off means no limit. When the limit is reached, the task stops and says where it stopped.
Add an external MCP server to expose its tools to Mika.
Cho phép HTTP với máy chủ cục bộ/riêng tư
External MCP servers are separate from Connect a computer. Their tools appear with an MCP source in tasks. HTTPS only by default; local HTTP needs the checkbox. Tokens stay on this phone.
Runs inside the Linux sandbox. Install the server there first.
Đang chờ đăng nhập trình duyệt…
Đã đăng nhập. Dùng Lưu và kiểm tra để kiểm tra công cụ.
Estimate DeepSeek API charges in Chinese yuan for new tasks.
Stops background tasks and hides the floating capsule
Tasks that are running will stop, and the floating capsule and notifications will go away. Open Mika again and everything comes back.
Ngân sách token mỗi tác vụ

Only provider-reported input and output tokens count. Once the budget is reached, no further requests are made. An in-flight request may take usage past the budget; calls without reported usage count as 0.
Enter a whole number from %1$s to %2$s.
Tự động lưu trữ trò chuyện
Chats without new messages for a while move to the archive
Chats without new messages for the chosen time are moved to the archive. Pinned chats and chats with a task running stay put. You can restore them from the archive in the chat list at any time.
Scheduled results and reminders appear silently in the notification shade.
Choose different start and end times to silence notifications.
Giới hạn thời gian tác vụ đã lên lịch
Scheduled tasks run while you’re away. Off means no limit; when time is up, the task stops and says it ran out of time.
